testsuite.name: com.zynergylabs.forager.app.data.backup.ScheduledBackupTest

testcase.name: the job keeps the newest 5 of its own backups, deleting the oldest beyond that, oldest first
a retry writes a backup with the setting off, and still refuses with no folder
changing how often, and turning it off and on again, run nothing at once either
the recorded list is stored and read back exactly, in order, and the permission flag starts unset
a delete that fails is logged at warn, the backup is still a success, and the file is not kept to fail again
a notice waiting to be shown at launch is stored and read back exactly, and clears
the worker reports a failed run, so a notification or an in-app notice follows
five backups delete nothing
a failed run records nothing and prunes nothing
the saved schedule is off, weekly and without a folder until the user sets it
a run with the setting off, or with no folder, writes nothing and reports a failure
a scheduled run writes one new file to the chosen folder, named by the date
the worker reports a failed run as a failure and logs why
the default file name is forager-backup, the date, dot zip
a record that cannot be read prunes nothing, is logged, and does not overwrite the record
the notification's Try again runs one backup to the saved folder although the schedule has been turned off
a folder that cannot be written is a failure the caller can see, not a success
enabling schedules one periodic job at the chosen frequency, and nothing is scheduled while it is off
an enabled setting with no folder is never scheduled
two runs make two files and nothing is removed
a scheduled run whose write fails deletes the file it created, and only that file
a scheduled run that meets unreadable photos skips them and saves the backup, reporting how many
the worker reports nothing for a clean run, and the skipped count for a run that left photos out
a saved schedule reads back exactly, for every frequency
a manual backup and any other file in the folder are never deleted, however old
Try again with the folder's permission gone tries the folder and posts the existing failure
turning the schedule on runs nothing at once, and one backup once the interval has passed
the worker runs the backup and reports success
a delete that fails is logged at warn and the run is still reported as a failure
a record that cannot be written deletes nothing, and is logged
